title.zh: 【Orca 与 Loopscale 合并，合并后团队将以「Formation」名义运营】
title.en: 【Orca 与 Loopscale 合并，合并后团队将以「Formation」名义运营】

current_state.zh: Orca 与 Loopscale 已完成合并并以 Formation 名义运营，由 Luke Truitt 任 CEO；Formation 总部位于纽约，计划为 AI、能源、机器人、国防资产提供融资，并在 12 个月内推出基于 SEC 创新豁免的代币化证券场所；ORCA 将作为整个 Formation 的代币，Loopscale 积分继续累积并将在今年晚些时候转换。
current_state.en: Orca and Loopscale have completed their merger and operate under the Formation brand, led by CEO Luke Truitt; Formation is headquartered in New York, plans to finance AI, energy, robotics, and defense assets, and intends to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months; ORCA will serve as the token for all of Formation, while Loopscale points keep accruing and will convert later this year.

updates.title_zh: 【Orca 与 Loopscale 合并，合并后团队将以「Formation」名义运营】
updates.title_en: 【Orca 与 Loopscale 合并，合并后团队将以「Formation」名义运营】
updates.what_changed_zh: Solana 流动性协议 Orca 与链上借贷协议 Loopscale 已完成合并，将以新名称 Formation 运营，由 Loopscale 联合创始人 Luke Truitt 出任 CEO，将交易/流动性基础设施与信贷和托管基础设施相结合，为资产提供从发行到融资和流动性的端到端路径。
updates.what_changed_en: Solana liquidity protocol Orca and on-chain lending protocol Loopscale have completed a merger and will operate under the new name Formation, led by Loopscale co-founder Luke Truitt as CEO, combining trading/liquidity infrastructure with credit and custody infrastructure to offer assets an end-to-end path from issuance to financing and liquidity.

updates.title_zh: Solana DeFi 公司 Orca 与 Loopscale 合并，启用新品牌 Formation
updates.title_en: Solana DeFi Firms Orca and Loopscale Merge Under New Formation Brand
updates.what_changed_zh: Formation 总部位于纽约；计划为 AI、能源、机器人、国防资产提供融资，并在 12 个月内根据 SEC 创新豁免推出代币化证券场所；ORCA 将作为整个 Formation 的代币，Loopscale 积分继续累积并将在今年晚些时候转换；管理层增加 Mary Gooneratne 任 COO、Christopher Montagano 任首席战略与法务官。
updates.what_changed_en: Formation is headquartered in New York; plans to finance AI, energy, robotics, and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months; ORCA will serve as the token for all of Formation, Loopscale points keep accruing and will convert later this year; management adds Mary Gooneratne as COO and Christopher Montagano as chief strategy and legal officer.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Solana DEX Orca and lending protocol Loopscale are merging into a New York-based company called Formation, which plans to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Solana DEX Orca and lending protocol Loopscale are merging into a New York-based company called Formation, which plans to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months.
